Research Opportunities

The lab’s currently published guidance states that new PhD research assistantship positions are not available. Interested candidates are welcome to contact the director about involvement and to confirm availability before applying.

Prospective PhD Students

Email Dr. Shahid with a short explanation of your research motivation and a comprehensive CV, including undergraduate grades and GRE and TOEFL/Duolingo scores as applicable. Use “Ph.D. Application – Your Name” as the subject.
